bordered.zh-CN: 是否展示边框，仅在非全屏模式下有效。
bordered.en-US: Whether to show a border. Only takes effect in non-full mode.

fullMode.en-US: Whether the banner is in full mode.

title.zh-CN: 纯文本标题；同时传入 title 插槽时以插槽为准。
title.en-US: Plain-text title. The title slot wins when both are given.

type.en-US: Type: info, success, danger or warning.

close.zh-CN: 点击关闭按钮时触发，载荷为按钮的原生 click 事件；监听器返回后横幅隐藏。
close.en-US: Emitted when the close button is clicked, with its native click event. The banner hides once the listeners return.

default.zh-CN: 消息下方的自定义内容。

icon.zh-CN: 替换类型图标；传入空插槽则不显示图标。
icon.en-US: Replaces the icon of the type. An empty slot hides the icon.

closeIcon.zh-CN: 替换关闭按钮内的图标；传入空插槽则不显示关闭按钮。
closeIcon.en-US: Replaces the icon in the close button. An empty slot removes the button.
